# Accuracy {scrolling="true"}

## Row {height=80px}

::: {.card}
Backtest: rolling out-of-sample forecasts, each made without that day's prices, but made afterwards, plus the live days so far.
The live forecasts are on the [main page](index.html).
:::

## Row {height=450px}

```{r}
#| title: "Accuracy"
if (has_eval) {
  acc <- eval_acc
  if (!is.null(mcs_models)) acc <- left_join(acc, mcs_models, by = "model")
  acc |>
    transmute(Model          = unname(long_labels[model]),
              `MAE (€/MWh)`  = round(mae, 1),
              `RMSE (€/MWh)` = round(rmse, 1),
              `rMAE`         = round(rmae, 3),
              `In MCS (10%)` = if ("in_mcs" %in% names(acc)) ifelse(in_mcs, "yes", "") else "") |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr")
}
```

## Row {height=720px}

::: {.card title="Is the difference significant?"}

Rolling out-of-sample forecasts, `r eval_period`, all models on the same hours.

`r acc_txt` `r sig_txt` `r live_txt`

```{r}
if (has_eval) {
  real_m  <- eval_acc$model[!grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)]
  naive_b <- eval_acc$model[grepl("^naive", eval_acc$model)][1]
  others <- setdiff(c(real_m, naive_b), real_m[1])
  bind_rows(lapply(others, \(o) {
    r <- find_test(eval_tests, real_m[1], o)
    if (is.null(r)) NULL else mutate(r, model_a = real_m[1], model_b = o)
  })) |>
    transmute(Comparison    = paste(long_labels[model_a], "vs", long_labels[model_b]),
              `MAE diff`    = round(mae_diff, 2),
              `DM p`        = p_tab(dm_p),
              `GW p`        = p_tab(gw_p),
              `Hours better / worse` = paste(hours_a_better, "/", hours_b_better)) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr")
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
tab_attr <- 'class="table table-sm table-striped small"'
if (has_prob) {
  tab1 <- prob_m |>
    arrange(pinball) |>
    transmute(Method                = paste0(unname(q_methods[method]), ifelse(chosen, " (used)", "")),
              Pinball               = round(pinball, 2),
              `Skill vs naive`      = if ("skill" %in% names(prob_m)) pct(skill) else "\u2013",
              `DM p vs best`        = ifelse(is.na(dm_p), "best", p_tab(dm_p)),
              `50% range covers`    = sprintf("%s (p %s)", pct(cov50), p_tab(cov50_p)),
              `90% range covers`    = sprintf("%s (p %s)", pct(cov90), p_tab(cov90_p)),
              `Width 50% / 90% (€/MWh)` = sprintf("%.1f / %.1f", width50, width90),
              `Calibration error`   = round(cal_error, 3))
  cat(knitr::kable(tab1, format = "html", align = "lrrrrrrr", table.attr = tab_attr))
  cat("\n\n", prob_txt, " ", neg_txt, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (!is.null(prob_cal)) {
    tab2 <- prob_cal |>
      filter(model == eval_main, tau %in% c(0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 0.95)) |>
      mutate(tau = paste0(round(100 * tau), "%"), below = pct(below)) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tau, values_from = below) |>
      transmute(`Share of prices below the quantile` = unname(q_methods[method]), across(ends_with("%")))
    cat(knitr::kable(tab2, format = "html", align = "lrrrrrrr", table.attr = tab_attr))
  }
}
```

# Variables

## Row {height=100%}

::: {.card title="Which variables help? Tick the groups to add"}

DK1 prices from D-1, D-2, D-3 and D-7 are always candidates. Each ticked group adds candidates,
and BMT picks from all of them. Results are from the backtest; every combination is precomputed.

```{r}
if (has_bmtx) {
  dat <- bmtx_combo |>
    left_join(bmtx_sel, by = "combo") |>
    mutate(rank = row_number(), label = sapply(combo, combo_txt)) |>
    select(combo, label, rank, mae, rmse, rmae, mcs_p, in_mcs,
           n_sel, n_prices, n_nb, n_wind, n_solar, n_hol)
  base_mae <- dat$mae[dat$combo == "prices"]
  htmltools::HTML(paste0('
<div class="group-picker">
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="nb"> Neighbour prices <small>DE, DK2, NO2, SE3, SE4, yesterday</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="wind"> Wind <small>forecast for tomorrow, published after the auction</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="solar"> Solar <small>forecast for tomorrow, published after the auction</small></label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" value="hol"> Holidays <small>tomorrow and today</small></label>
</div>
<div id="combo-result" class="combo-result"></div>
<script>
(function() {
  var data = ', jsonlite::toJSON(dat, dataframe = "rows", digits = 4), ';
  var base = ', base_mae, ';
  var n = data.length;
  var order = ["nb", "wind", "solar", "hol"];
  function key() {
    var on = order.filter(function(g) {
      return document.querySelector(".group-picker input[value=" + g + "]").checked;
    });
    return on.length ? on.join("+") : "prices";
  }
  function f(x, d) { return Number(x).toFixed(d); }
  function render() {
    var r = data.find(function(x) { return x.combo === key(); });
    var diff = r.mae - base;
    var mcs = r.in_mcs
      ? "<span class=\'tag good\'>in the model confidence set</span> (p = " + f(r.mcs_p, 2) + ")"
      : "<span class=\'tag\'>not in the model confidence set</span> (p = " + f(r.mcs_p, 3) + ")";
    document.getElementById("combo-result").innerHTML =
      "<div class=\'combo-name\'>" + r.label + "</div>" +
      "<div class=\'combo-stats\'>" +
      "<div><span>MAE</span><b>" + f(r.mae, 1) + "</b><small>" +
        (r.combo === "prices" ? "baseline" : (diff <= 0 ? "\u2212" : "+") + f(Math.abs(diff), 1) + " vs prices only") + "</small></div>" +
      "<div><span>RMSE</span><b>" + f(r.rmse, 1) + "</b><small>\u20ac/MWh</small></div>" +
      "<div><span>Rank</span><b>" + r.rank + " / " + n + "</b><small>by MAE</small></div>" +
      "</div>" +
      "<p>" + mcs + "</p>" +
      "<p>BMT picks on average " + f(r.n_sel, 1) + " variables per hour: " +
      f(r.n_prices, 1) + " DK1 prices" +
      (r.n_nb > 0 || key().indexOf("nb") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_nb, 1) + " neighbour prices" : "") +
      (r.n_wind > 0 || key().indexOf("wind") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_wind, 1) + " wind" : "") +
      (r.n_solar > 0 || key().indexOf("solar") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_solar, 1) + " solar" : "") +
      (r.n_hol > 0 || key().indexOf("hol") >= 0 ? ", " + f(r.n_hol, 1) + " holiday" : "") + ".</p>";
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".group-picker input").forEach(function(i) {
    i.addEventListener("change", render);
  });
  render();
})();
</script>'))
} else {
  cat("Run scripts/08_bmtx.R and 10_evaluate.R to add the BMT-X results.")
}
```

```{r}
if (!has_battery) {
  cat("Run scripts/11_battery.R to add the battery backtest.")

  p3 <- plot_ly(bat_daily, x = ~date)
  for (s in intersect(names(long_labels), names(bat_daily))) {
    p3 <- p3 |>
      add_lines(y = cumsum(bat_daily[[s]]), name = long_labels[[s]],

}
```

```{r}
}
```

::: {.card title="How it works"}

Each day a `r bat_desc` plans its charging and selling for tomorrow using the forecast,
and is then paid the actual prices. The chart and table cover `r bat_period` (live days are added
once every model has a saved forecast). Perfect foresight plans with the actual prices and is the upper bound.

`r bat_txt`

No fees, no battery wear, hourly instead of 15-minute trading.

:::

```{r}
#| title: "Backtest: four ways to build the scenarios"
if (has_risk) {
  risk_tests |>
    transmute(Method                        = paste0(label, ifelse(used, " (used)", "")),
              `Days below the floor`        = sprintf("%s (%d of %d)", pct(miss_rate), misses, days),
              `Kupiec p`                    = p_tab(kupiec_p),
              `Christoffersen p`            = ifelse(is.na(christoffersen_p), "\u2013", p_tab(christoffersen_p)),
              `Acerbi–Székely p`            = p_tab(z2_p),
              `FZ0 score`                   = format(round(fz0, 2), nsmall = 2),
              `DM p vs best`                = ifelse(is.na(dm_p), "best", p_tab(dm_p)),
              `VaR / ES (€)`                = paste(sapply(var, eur), "/", sapply(es, eur)),
              `Live misses`                 = ifelse(live_days > 0, sprintf("%d of %d", live_misses, live_days), "\u2013")) |>
    knitr::kable(align = "lrrrrrrrr")
}
```

## Row {height=360px}

::: {.card title="How it works"}

The battery's plan for tomorrow is made on the ensemble forecast before the auction. With the plan fixed,
its revenue is the plan times the prices, so the risk comes from the forecast errors in the hours it
trades. The scenarios are the 24-hour errors of past days, kept whole so the hours stay correlated, run
through tomorrow's plan. VaR is how far below the expected revenue the worst day in 20 falls; ES is the
average shortfall on those days. VaR and ES in the table are averages over the days.

Four ways to build the scenarios: the errors of the last 60 days as they were, the same scaled by last
week's price volatility, a normal distribution with their mean and spread, and filtered historical
simulation, where each past day's errors are scaled by an EWMA of the forecast errors before it
(λ = 0.94) and up to 250 days are used.

Tests: Kupiec (is the share of days below the floor 5%), Christoffersen (do those days come in
clusters) and Acerbi–Székely (are those days worse than the ES says), with simulated p-values since
there are few misses. The method used passes all three at 5% and then has the lowest FZ0 score, which
rates VaR and ES together (Patton, Ziegel & Chen 2019). The EWMA method was added on 12 October 2026,
after the first three failed, so the live days are its real test.

`r risk_txt`

No fees, no battery wear, hourly instead of 15-minute trading, as in the battery backtest.

:::
